title: kate-core: read editorconfig from one handle
summary: The change is in push_layer. Check is_file on the path before File::open so a FIFO does not block. Then open a regular file and re-check metadata on the handle. Read with take of the cap plus one. A larger read is skipped and not parsed. The FIFO test runs mkfifo through std::process::Command and times out the open at about 5 seconds. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust. It does not need a window or a review by the owner. Linux CI runs the tests. Also run cargo check for aarch64-apple-darwin.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: The change is in push_layer. Check path metadata is_file before File::open. A FIFO is not a regular file, so open is not called. Then open the regular file. Re-check metadata on that handle. If the handle is not a file or its length is over the cap, return without reading. Otherwise read with take(MAX_EDITORCONFIG_BYTES + 1). If the string is longer than the cap, skip it and do not parse it. A skipped file does not set root. Keep the directory test and the oversized test. Add a unix-only FIFO test. The test creates the FIFO by running the mkfifo command through std::process::Command. It adds no new dependency. The test runs the open on a thread. The timeout is about 5 seconds. A regression fails. The call does not hang. Do not edit workspace.rs. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: modeline::tests::read_capped_stops_past_the_cap
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because read_capped does not exist. A handle whose bytes exceed the cap returns Ok(None). A small root = true file returns that text.

regression_tests.name: modeline::tests::a_fifo_editorconfig_returns_promptly
regression_tests.asserts: This test is cfg unix. The test creates the FIFO by running the mkfifo command through std::process::Command. It adds no new dependency. A FIFO named .editorconfig is not a regular file. push_layer checks is_file on the path before File::open. The test runs the open on a thread. The timeout is about 5 seconds. A regression fails. The call does not hang. read_editorconfig returns with no writer.
